### 📓 Docs Drift Check
**2** anchor(s) derived from **3** changed package(s); no hand-written page names any of them, so this run has **nothing to list** — **not a clean bill of health**. This check sees only pages that NAME a derived anchor: one that documents this change in prose, or enumerates it in an authoring dialect, names none and stays invisible to it on every run.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **2** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **65** of **247** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **182** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **182**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **123** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **178** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 7be32d39fa62bd6e0f7c0a0054569b22bfb3dfd3` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `c6cdbc0a9a31a6484d6fa0f698d1464fcacc04b1` — the merge of head `508098ea8e0580aa38e0b80078ed669f9d1b0551` into base `7be32d39fa62bd6e0f7c0a0054569b22bfb3dfd3`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin c6cdbc0a9a31a6484d6fa0f698d1464fcacc04b1 && git checkout c6cdbc0a9a31a6484d6fa0f698d1464fcacc04b1
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 7be32d39fa62bd6e0f7c0a0054569b22bfb3dfd3 508098ea8e0580aa38e0b80078ed669f9d1b0551 && git checkout -B drift-repro 7be32d39fa62bd6e0f7c0a0054569b22bfb3dfd3 && git merge --no-ff 508098ea8e0580aa38e0b80078ed669f9d1b0551

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 7be32d39fa62bd6e0f7c0a0054569b22bfb3dfd3
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `afe14ddf00d97545514ac0dbdbd307eb6a66dfea`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/kernel/public-auth-features.ts, packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-user.object.ts, packages/platform-objects/src/identity/action-state-visibility.test.ts, packages/platform-objects/src/identity/cloud-managed-visibility.test.ts, packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-user-set-manager-action.test.ts, packages/platform-objects/src/platform-objects.test.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/pending-sso-users.test.ts + packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-plugin.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/admin-user-endpoints.ts, packages/platform-objects/src/feature-gate-guard.test.ts, packages/spec/src/api/auth-endpoints.zod.ts (cited, read at the head, not reviewed)

Read at 2026-11-15T23:07Z. First review of this head, taken on patrol as owed; claim: comment 6902838839. Independence: implemented in an os-steve project thread; neither dispatched nor implemented by os-tesla.

Inputs read: cards #34010 and #34130 with their claims, scope-addition comment 6900996719 and both os-dev-reports; this PR's body and comments; the net diff from merge base `27c2f1ea` to the head; the cited doors at the head; the head's check-runs. Nothing was built or run.

### ① Derived judgments

1. **`sys_user.unlock_user` and `sys_user.set_user_password` lose the lowered `&& features.admin == true` conjunct, and nothing else.** Right. The diff removes one `requiresFeature: 'admin'` line from each action. `target`, `requiredPermissions`, `recordIdParam`, `bodyExtra`, params and `ai` are untouched; the authored `visible` of each is byte-identical.
2. **Each action is now offered where its door answers.** Right, read in the cited code.
   - Unlock: `admin/unlock-user` is mounted in an unconditional block of `auth-plugin.ts` and clears the lock through `AuthManager.unlockUser`, with no read of the vendor plugin. Offered to a platform administrator on a row with a lock stamp or two-factor enabled, with the plugin on or off, managed or not. The live pin drives all three kernels.
   - Set Password: `admin/set-user-password` is mounted in the same unconditional block; `runAdminSetUserPassword` hashes and writes through the core `internalAdapter`, stamps and revokes through the data engine. Offered to a platform administrator when `features.cloudManaged` is not true. On a cloud-managed environment the door refuses every target and the action stays hidden, so the hide and the refusal agree.
   - `create_user` and `impersonate_user` keep the gate; the CONTROL roster pins exactly those two as the remaining readers of `features.admin`.
3. **Visibility is not the permission.** Right. Both doors run the platform-admin gate before any write (`judgePlatformAdmin` in the unlock mount, `gateAdmin` in the set-password mount), and neither reads `visible` or `features`. Both live pins send the declared call as a signed-in caller without the standing, with the plugin off, and read `403 PERMISSION_DENIED` with the row unchanged (the lock held; the new password did not sign in).
4. **`PUBLIC_AUTH_FEATURES.admin.gatedInputs` goes from four booked paths to two.** Right and forced: `feature-gate-guard.test.ts` holds the registry and the lowered predicates equal in both directions. `sys_user.actions.set_user_password` stays booked under `cloudManaged`, which is the flag it still reads. Export name, entry shape and semantics are unchanged; no generated artifact holds the two strings, and the lanes that carry `check:generated` and `check:api-surface` are green on the head.
5. **No consumer needed an edit.** Right. The console and the SDK read the served `visible`; no file under `ui/` names either booked path or hard-codes the gate, and `Type Check UI` is green on the head.
6. **Pins.** Unlock: plugin off unmanaged (live), plugin off managed (live), plugin on (CONTROL, live). Set Password: plugin off unmanaged (live), plugin off managed (hidden), plugin on (CONTROL, live). The offer tables in `action-state-visibility.test.ts`, the lowering-matrix rows and the new `cloud-managed-visibility.test.ts` case hold the predicate shape. The reported ablations name the cases that red when either gate is put back; they were read, not re-run.

### ② Semver level

Clause-②: no — upheld, on the reading record 6897296837 gave the same drop for ban and unban. No accepted input set and no door moves; an existing action is offered in more kernels. `Metadata-protocol: none` is right: no key an author can write is added, removed or re-meant (`requiresFeature` stays authorable with the same vocabulary). Both changesets name `@objectstack/platform-objects` and `@objectstack/spec` at `patch`, which matches. Residual, as that record stated it: the `as const` tuple loses two literal members, so an outside consumer typed against those literals would stop compiling; no reader in this repository does.

CI on the head, 71 check-runs: 56 success, 13 skipped, 2 failure, none pending. The two failures are `Test Core (7/8)` and its aggregate `Test Core` (run 43763278713, attempt 1). The only failing task is `@objectstack/scenarios#test`: three cases of `packages/qa/scenarios/test/runner/run-date.test.ts`, each `Test timed out in 5000ms`, the signature ledgered at #34081 and the same one the seat read on the previous head. The diff touches nothing under `packages/qa/`. This PASS is a verdict on the contract. It is not a statement that CI is green: the head is red until that job is re-run and passes, and it does not go to the queue before then.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **`Waits-on: #34119` is still open.** PR #34119 has not merged. This head therefore carries the gate drop without the describe correction (S1). When this PR takes that correction it edits `packages/spec/src/api/auth-endpoints.zod.ts`, a schema-face file, and that new head owes its own review; this record covers `afe14ddf` only.
- **Card #34130, "hidden for non-local accounts, as today".** Confirmed as the PR reads it: the predicate at the merge base holds no identity-source rule, so there was none to keep. See N3 for the cell this leaves.
- **Card #34130 scope additions (6900996719).** One of three stale copies is corrected here (the block header). The other two are outside the claim's file surface and are not carried by a card (S2).
- **Deviation, forced edit to `cloud-managed-visibility.test.ts`:** accepted. Its "keeps its other flag" case assumed all six doors read a second flag; five do now, and the sixth has its own case in both directions.
- **Deviation, shared harness helpers moved to module scope and `actionCall` now sends `bodyExtra`:** accepted. The move is verbatim, and ban, unban and unlock declare no `bodyExtra`, so their calls are unchanged.
- **`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-plugin.ts` untouched:** confirmed. PR #34050, which held it, has since merged; nothing here depends on its hunks.
- **Security discipline:** no finding. No mechanism note was written for this head.

### ④ Design judgment

No must-fix.

S1 (should-fix) — the published `features.admin` describe is made false by this diff and is not corrected in it. `packages/spec/src/api/auth-endpoints.zod.ts` says user administration, "unlocking" and "setting their passwords" included, is shown by the console "only when it is true", and `content/docs/references/api/auth-endpoints.mdx` is generated from it. After this head the console shows both with the value false. The PR defers the sentence to the merge of #34119; that is an acceptable order, but it must land with this change or with #34119, whichever is second, and the PR body is the only place that says so.

S2 (should-fix) — `Fixes #34130` closes a card with two of its scope additions still open and no card carrying them: the comment in `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-manager-plugin-list.ts` that lists set-password among what the vendor plugin provides, and `content/docs/permissions/authentication.mdx`, whose "Admin User Management (requires `plugins.admin`)" heading still covers `set-user-password` and `unlock-user`, whose exception sentence below it names only ban, unban and the two SSO doors, and whose earlier section ties the `set_user_password` action to `plugins: { admin: true }`. "Carrier: seat" is not a carrier. File the follow-up card, or take the edits, before this merges.

N1 (nit) — the comment on `set_user_password`'s `visible` says the server "keeps answering it on an `env_native` row" on a cloud-managed environment. The door at the head refuses every target there, and this PR's own changeset says so. The line sits beside the removed gate and now contradicts the header above it.

N2 (nit) — changeset `34010-unlock-without-admin-plugin.md` ships its declaration lines with the claim's conditional wording ("no for a gate drop (… the dev verifies against that record)", "none unless the action's declared shape changes"). The conditions resolved to `no` and `none`; the published CHANGELOG should say that, as the second changeset does.

N3 (nit) — one offered-but-refused cell remains for Set Password: in SSO-only mode the door refuses a target provisioned by the identity provider, and the predicate reads no row state, so the button is shown on that row. This is unchanged in kind and now reaches kernels without the plugin as well. It needs a row rule and its own card, not this PR.

N4 (nit) — the Set Password pin sends `mustChangePassword: false` and `revokeSessionsAndKeys: false`, while the action's defaults are both true. The default path was read in `admin-user-endpoints.ts` and has no vendor-plugin dependency, but no committed test drives it with the plugin off.

N5 (nit) — `content/docs/protocol/objectui/actions.mdx` still teaches `requiresFeature: admin` on `ban_user` as its example. Stale since #33989 and outside this diff; it belongs with S2's follow-up.

**`packages/spec/src/kernel/public-auth-features.ts`** (hits). Holds against both cards and against its first consumer, the lockstep guard. The inline comment's claim, that the four doors are ObjectStack mounts that work without the vendor plugin, was read true in the cited mounts and is measured by the live pins. `admin` keeps two booked paths, so the entry still satisfies the registry's own gated-or-exempt rule.

**`packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-user.object.ts`** (implementing). Agrees with the contract for both actions. The rewritten block header states the measured split and corrects the two sentences record 6897296837 named. Attempts to break it: a caller without the standing (refused at both doors, pinned); the managed kernel (Unlock offered and works, Set Password hidden and refused); the default body of Set Password (N4); a row the door refuses while the button shows (N3). None is a defect of this diff.

**The five test files** (implementing). Each asserts what its title says, on the parsed object and through the real mounts; the CONTROL cases hold the plugin-on behaviour and the two actions that keep the gate.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `a2f47bbd68b874948268a9bb91448736332d50cc`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/api/auth-endpoints.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/kernel/public-auth-features.ts, packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-user.object.ts, packages/platform-objects/src/identity/action-state-visibility.test.ts, packages/platform-objects/src/identity/cloud-managed-visibility.test.ts, packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-user-set-manager-action.test.ts, packages/platform-objects/src/platform-objects.test.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-manager-plugin-list.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/pending-sso-users.test.ts + packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-plugin.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/admin-user-endpoints.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/admin-import-users.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/cloud-managed.ts, packages/spec/src/system/auth-config.zod.ts, packages/platform-objects/src/feature-gate-guard.test.ts (cited, read at the head, not reviewed)

Read at 2026-11-16T02:03Z. Delta review of this head against PASS 6902922670 at afe14ddf; claim: comment 6904891771; lane request 6904877424 on mailbox #33873. Independence: implemented in an os-steve project thread, dispatched by domain:ui#1 (os-steve); reviewed by os-tesla, who neither dispatched nor implemented it.

Inputs read: cards #34010 and #34130 with the scope-addition comment 6900996719 and the round-3 os-dev-report 6904842273; this PR's body and comments, the handoff 6904865648 included; card #34225; claim amendment 6903911896 on #34010; the merge `029cfa72` and the commit `a2f47bbd`; the cited code at the head; the head's check-runs. Nothing was built or run.

### ① Derived judgments

1. **The net change since `afe14ddf` is `a2f47bbd` and nothing else.** Right. The merge of main `571cf908` was not hand-resolved: its tree equals the tree git computes for the two parents on its own (`732bd8b2`). The net diff from the old merge base `27c2f1ea` to `afe14ddf` is identical, hunk for hunk, to the net diff from `571cf908` to the merge commit. So everything record 6902922670 judged stands unchanged on the new base, and its ① items 1 to 6 are carried.
2. **`a2f47bbd` changes no behaviour.** Right. One describe string, one generated page, two code comments, one hand-written doc page, two changesets, one added test case. No action field, no door, no gate and no booked path moves; `public-auth-features.ts` is not in the commit.
3. **The `features.admin` describe now matches what the console reads.** Right. Sentence one (creating and impersonating users, shown only when the value is true) holds: `create_user` and `impersonate_user` are the two actions that keep the gate, pinned by the CONTROL roster. Sentence two (banning, unbanning, unlocking and setting a password answer without the plugin, and whether the console offers them does not depend on the value) holds: none of the four actions reads `features.admin` at the head. The overlap with #34119 is clean: #34119 wrote the sentence this commit rewrites, the merge took main's text, and the commit edits it on top.
4. **The generated reference page agrees with the describe.** Right. Both `admin` rows of `content/docs/references/api/auth-endpoints.mdx` carry the head's describe verbatim.
5. **`plugins.admin` in `auth-config.zod.ts` needed no edit.** Right. Read at the head: it lists create, impersonate and the vendor routes as the plugin's, names ban, unban, unlock and set-password as served without it, and says nothing about console buttons.
6. **The plugin-list comment and the authentication page state the measured split.** Right. `create-user` and `import-users` answer `501 NOT_IMPLEMENTED` without the plugin (read in `auth-plugin.ts` and `admin-import-users.ts`); the other six doors in the list answer with or without it. No "requires `plugins.admin`" wording is left on the page for unlock or set-password, and the earlier paragraph now ties only user creation to the plugin.
7. **The new pin drives the default body.** Right as written. It reads the declared defaults off the action itself, asserts they are exactly `mustChangePassword: true` and `revokeSessionsAndKeys: true`, sends them as the platform administrator on a kernel whose served `features.admin` is false, and reads the flag set, the sessions stamped revoked, and the new password signing in. Read, not run; the lane that runs it is still in progress (②).

### ② Semver level

Clause-②: no — upheld, unchanged from record 6902922670. Round 3 adds a description string on a published schema and prose; no accepted input set, no door and no export shape moves. `Metadata-protocol: none` stays right. Both changesets name `@objectstack/platform-objects` and `@objectstack/spec` at `patch`; the 34130 note now also records the describe correction, under the spec patch it already declared.

CI on the head, 49 check-runs so far: 19 success, 11 skipped, 19 in progress, none failed. In progress: `Test Core` (all 8 shards), `Build Core`, `Build Docs`, `Build UI Deps`, `Live E2E UI`, three `Type Check` lanes and four `Lint` lanes. ⛔ This PASS is a verdict on the contract, rendered while checks run. It is not a statement that CI is green. The seat waits for every run to complete and reads them before this head goes to the queue; in particular the lanes that carry `check:generated`, the docs build and the new pin have not reported yet.

CI completed before posting: 72 check-runs, 60 success, 12 skipped, 0 failed, none in progress.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **`Waits-on: #34119`: met.** #34119 merged as `41ff7c34` and is in this head's base.
- **Schema-face file now in the diff.** `packages/spec/src/api/auth-endpoints.zod.ts` is edited by this head, as the previous record said it would be; this record is the review that head owed. The edit is one sentence of a describe.
- **Card #34130 scope additions (6900996719): all taken here.** The three stale copies (the `sys-user.object.ts` block header, the `auth-manager-plugin-list.ts` comment, the `authentication.mdx` heading with its exception line and earlier paragraph) are corrected in this PR, and the test addition is met by the live pins. The card's own last ask, that the describe sentence moves in the same PR, is met. `Fixes #34130` and `Fixes #34010` are right: nothing either card asked for is left without a carrier.
- **Prior N3 is carried by card #34225**, open, `domain:ui`, filed by the lane seat and naming this PR and record. It is not this PR's to fix.
- **Prior N5 needed no edit here.** On main since #34119, the `requiresFeature: admin` example in `actions.mdx` is `impersonate_user`, an action that keeps the gate.
- **Claim file surface.** The round-3 edits to `auth-endpoints.zod.ts`, `auth-manager-plugin-list.ts` and `authentication.mdx` sit outside the surface of claim 6901469419. Claim amendment 6903911896 on #34010, by the lane seat, adds exactly those files (a describe sentence, a comment, a heading); read, and the edits stay inside it. The amendment also lists `auth-config.zod.ts` and `actions.mdx`, which needed no edit (① 5, and the N5 flag above).
- **Security discipline:** no finding at the rule layer. Round 3 moves no door and no gate; the standing rule (the offer is not the permission, both doors run the platform-admin gate before any write) is as the previous record read it.

### ④ Design judgment

No must-fix, no should-fix.

Status of the previous record's findings:

- S1: closed. The describe and its generated page are corrected in this head (① 3 and 4).
- S2: closed. Both open scope additions are taken in this head, and `Fixes` is right (③).
- N1: closed. The `visible` comment on `set_user_password` now says the door refuses every target on a cloud-managed environment, which is what `admin-user-endpoints.ts` and `cloud-managed.ts` do at the head.
- N2: closed. `34010-unlock-without-admin-plugin.md` ships plain `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none`.
- N3: carried by #34225 (③).
- N4: closed by the new pin (① 7).
- N5: closed on main by #34119 (③).

N1 (nit, new) — in `content/docs/permissions/authentication.mdx` the "Admin User Management" paragraph still says "All three routes" right after a sentence that now names two of them and their different plugin needs. The third (bulk import, which needs the plugin) is only named further down. The sentence is true and predates this PR; it reads less clearly after the edit. No effect on the contract.

**`packages/spec/src/api/auth-endpoints.zod.ts`** (hits). Holds against the card (#34130's last ask), against the code it describes (the four actions and the two that keep the gate) and against its first consumer, the generated reference page. The wording says what the value does not decide and makes no new promise about when each button shows, which is right: Unlock and Set Password each keep another rule.

**`packages/spec/src/kernel/public-auth-features.ts`** (hits). Unchanged since `afe14ddf`; the previous record's judgment stands.

**`packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-user.object.ts`** (implementing). Comment only in round 3; it now agrees with the block header above it and with the door.

**`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-manager-plugin-list.ts`** (implementing). Comment only. It names what the vendor plugin carries and what is served without it, and agrees with `auth-config.zod.ts`, which it cites.

**`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/pending-sso-users.test.ts`** (implementing).
